mechanism: Furosemide may reduce renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, potentially decreasing ceftazidime clearance and increasing antibiotic levels, while ceftazidime may theoretically compete for renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor renal function and ceftazidime levels in patients with pre-existing renal impairment; adjust ceftazidime dosing based on creatinine clearance and clinical response.
